because: Counterexamples on c51cdc9: a never-authenticated connection had 50 replayed handshakes signature-checked (replay was skipped, not refused, before authentication); one pinned peer authenticated 4 connections (up to the listener's 100), outside ADR-0013's two-per-pair bound.
statement: A connection whose first frame does not authenticate is closed, a replayed copy of a valid frame included, so an unauthenticated connection costs at most one signature verification. A pinned peer holds at most two authenticated connections, the bound from which inbound_worst_case and REPLAY_PER_SENDER are derived; a third is refused.
